title: Community Repair Workshop Plan
subtitle: Review the event plan, comment on specific sections, and decide whether it is ready to schedule.
agent_help: Read the plan in order, inspect each visual or its text alternative, comment on any block that needs attention, then record the final decision.
document_description: A one-day neighborhood event with three practical repair sessions.

global_actions.label: Defer for later
global_actions.description: Leave the plan for a future review.

global_actions.label: Needs specialist input
global_actions.description: Ask a venue, accessibility, or safety specialist to review the plan.

blocks.title: Plan decision
blocks.body: Choose every outcome that should return to the event team. Conflicting choices remain visible until corrected.
blocks.question: What should happen with this plan?

actions.label: Approve the plan
actions.description: Schedule the workshop using the proposed structure and budget.

actions.label: Request revisions
actions.description: Return specific changes before the workshop is scheduled.

actions.label: Add follow-up work
actions.description: Keep the plan and record additional preparation separately.
